stories.title: US imposes 50% tariffs on Canadian goods after trade talks collapse
new_facts: First report: US imposes 50% tariff on $20bn Canadian imports; Canada vows dollar-for-dollar retaliation.
Names Mark Carney as PM who suspended talks after days of negotiations ended in impasse.
Reveals Trump extended the original tariff deadline by three days before it took effect.
Adds US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, who called it a 'missed opportunity for Canada.'
Adds Trump quote saying the US 'should be able to have a deal with Canada' before deadline.
New Greer quote accusing Canada of 'continuing its retaliation against the US.'
stories.line: US imposes 50% tariffs on $20 billion in Canadian goods after trade negotiations fail; Canada says it will retaliate in kind.

stories.line: Germany legalizes recreational cannabis, creating Europe's biggest regulated market for the drug.

stories.line: Sonar scans of a formation on Mount Ararat suggest it may contain wood, reigniting claims it could be Noah's Ark.

new_facts: New Trump quote urging supporters to 'pretend' he's on the midterm ballot.

Trump quipped the protester's 'Mom is voting for us' in response to the heckler.
Sen. Tim Scott appeared at the rally to hype the crowd for Darline Graham.
Reports that segments of Trump's MAGA base remain unconvinced about Darline Graham ahead of the runoff.
Trump rallied for appointed Sen. Darline Graham ahead of Tuesday's SC GOP Senate runoff; MAGA base split.
Trump dismissed debate-stumble criticism, calling Graham 'very smart' at Myrtle Beach rally.
Trump stumped for Graham Friday night; runoff described as days away; panel of reporters analyze race.
stories.line: Trump campaigns for Republican Senate candidates by asking supporters to imagine he's on the ballot, weeks before midterms.
